crestoperations-crestoperations:lever:3c.title: Construction Manager Team Leader
crestoperations-crestoperations:lever:3c.description: We understand that finding the right place to work isn't easy. At Beta Engineering, we believe in cultivating a team that wins together and takes on the most challenging projects in the high-voltage industry. We engineer, procure, and construct (EPC) projects for a variety of customers, including those in the utility, industrial, and renewable energy markets. Our work includes substations, transmission lines and more. We help our customers achieve their goals of creating a stronger power grid by reducing risks and identifying innovative solutions for their project challenges. Our Purpose: We pursue that which challenges us, growing our community to provide critical, creative solutions that achieve extraordinary results. Our Values: We do what we say, we turn challenges into success and we win together. The Construction Manager Team Leader (CMTL) supervise Construction Managers (CM) and oversees a portfolio of project sites as assigned throughout the US. CMTL is tasked with the total construction effort of their portfolio in accordance with safety, design and schedule set by Beta Engineering standards and customer contract. The CMTLs are responsible for training, recruiting, scheduling, retaining, assigning and management of CMs under their supervision. This role will perform additional duties as assigned. ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES: Directly supervises assigned CMs. Carries out supervisory responsibilities in accordance with Crest's and Beta's policies and applicable laws Regularly reports to Manager of Construction Management and assists with the planning of assigned work Oversee a portfolio of projects to ensure safe execution, quality installation, and on-time performance while remaining within project budget Leads and mentors CMs to improve their individual and team performance to deliver on Beta’s commitments Ensures that CMs are trained in and implement Beta’s Safety Program and OSHA regulations Support CMs with subcontractor safety issues and perform on-site safety audits to document compliance, and addresses safety issues Ensures that CMs are trained in the implementation of Beta’s QA/QC to support quality oversight on assigned projects ensuring that subcontractors are using correct techniques and acceptable standards to construct the project to Beta’s standards and drawings Manages the CM’s training and certifications as outlined in Beta’s training matrix CM’s first point of contact for all day-to-day needs Supports CM in subcontractor management and maintaining relationships Assists CM in budget and projection updates for Project Manager Provides support to CM in scheduling of activities that drive construction for both the Beta Team and Subcontractor Supports CM in evaluating and managing procurement activities that facilitate construction progress Review and ensure timely submittal of required daily/ weekly and ad hoc reports for submittal to project team; including documentation collected from the customer and/or subcontractor Interpret policies as required Supports Project Manager or CM to address site specific construction issues and bring resolution by an increased site presence Manages the logistics of CM’s needs, such as transportation, communications, office materials, and job specific requirements Support job supervision on specialized equipment installations Provides temporary CM duties during rotation trips or when no CM is available for the Project Provides input on organizational structure, employee performance, employee development and disciplinary actions Additional duties as assigned by the Manager of Construction Management EXPECTATIONS: This position requires company paid travel and accommodation from site to site. jobgether-jobgether:lever:045684bd-ee3b-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Analista de Talent Acquisition based in Brazil. This role offers the opportunity to act as a strategic talent partner in a fast-paced, internationally oriented environment. You will work closely with business leaders to understand workforce needs and translate them into effective talent acquisition strategies. The position combines end-to-end recruitment, proactive sourcing, competency assessment, and talent market intelligence. You will use recruitment data and KPIs to improve hiring efficiency, quality, and candidate experience. The role also provides exposure to international recruitment and opportunities to contribute to employer branding initiatives. Success requires a balance of analytical thinking, strong interpersonal skills, and the ability to influence stakeholders. It is an excellent opportunity for a Talent Acquisition professional looking to expand their impact beyond traditional recruiting. Act as a strategic talent advisor and primary point of contact for business leaders, providing insights on talent markets, attraction strategies, competency profiles, and workforce needs. Manage the full recruitment lifecycle , from intake and sourcing through candidate assessment, selection, and closing, ensuring quality, efficiency, candidate experience, and adherence to SLAs. Develop proactive sourcing strategies to identify and engage high-performing talent through multiple channels and build pipelines for strategic and hard-to-fill positions. Identify opportunities to optimize recruiting processes, workflows, and candidate experience through data-driven improvements. Support employer branding initiatives designed to strengthen the organization’s positioning as an attractive destination for high-quality talent. Build trusted relationships with candidates and internal stakeholders, acting as a consultative partner throughout the hiring process. Contribute to international recruitment initiatives and adapt sourcing and selection approaches to different markets and talent pools. Requirements: Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Psychology, Human Resources , or a related field; postgraduate education is a plus. At least 3 years of solid experience in Recruitment & Selection , with hands-on experience managing the full recruitment cycle. Fluent English is required for communication with international candidates and stakeholders. Demonstrated analytical ability, with experience using recruitment data and KPIs to support decisions and define talent acquisition strategies. Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to establish trusted relationships with senior leaders, hiring managers, and candidates. Strong consultative mindset and the ability to understand business needs and translate them into effective recruiting strategies. Excellent organization and prioritization skills, with the ability to manage multiple vacancies and stakeholders simultaneously. Experience with ATS platforms and sourcing tools , particularly LinkedIn Recruiter, is desirable. Previous experience with international recruitment across different geographies is a strong advantage. Experience in consulting, financial services, technology, legal services, or other high-performance professional environments is a plus. skelar-skelar:ashbyhq:a3617787-2120-4784.description: [https://app.ashbyhq.com/api/images/user-content/586ac3cb-f234-40cf-96fd-3daae8c41309/3a2721ac-0cf6-4bb5-a785-483b8d1018c3/Ashby_header.png] Що варто знати про SKELAR? Це венчур-білдер — іншими словами, компанія, яка будує компанії. Загалом tech-продуктами наших бізнесів користуються 10+ млн людей у світі. Усе завдяки сильним командам, бо наші спеціалісти — це ключова цінність SKELAR. Для професійної реалізації ми створили середовище з експертизою та необмеженими можливостями — і шукаємо тих, хто прагне викликів.
